lead.en: An ontological prolegomenon in the first person: the argument that time measures change rather than constituting a thing, and that Possibility/Modality is the horizon of the not-yet.

items.en: Time is a relational metric, not an ontological axis.
The fourth dimension is Information/Structure: the architecture of the actual.
The fifth is Possibility/Modality: the horizon of what is not yet but could be.

text.en: The founder's full text is written in the first person and has not been reproduced here. This record states what the declaration claims, where it is used on this site, and what would refute it.
